title: WatchOutYourLife
description: In this plugin, I have created a brand new level system. It will award a certain maximum health bonus to players based on the amount of damage they have dealt.
body:
**Core mechanism**

Upgrade condition: Accumulate a certain amount of damage (not kills, but damage values)
Lv1→Lv2: 10,000 damage
Lv2→Lv3: 15,000 damage
Lv3→Lv4: 20,000 damage (5,000 more per level)
Attribute enhancement

Each level up increases the maximum health by 2 points
Lv1: 20 health points, Lv2: 22 health points, Lv 28 health points
Display mode5:

Use BossBar to display above the inventory
Display format: Level: X/Current Damage/Required Damage
Maximum level display: ★ Level: X (MAX) ★
Instruction

/level - View your level information
/setmaxlevel < level > - Real-time modification of the maximum level limit (op permission required)
Configuration

Default maximum level: Level 5
Permissions nodes: watchoutyourlife.level (default true), watchoutyourlife.setmaxlevel (op)

**核心机制：**

升级条件：累计造成一定伤害（不是击杀，是伤害数值）
Lv1→Lv2: 10000 伤害
Lv2→Lv3: 15000 伤害
Lv3→Lv4: 20000 伤害（每级增加 5000）
属性提升：

每升一级增加 2 点最大生命值
Lv1: 20 血，Lv2: 22 血，Lv5: 28 血
显示方式：

使用 BossBar 显示在物品栏上方
显示格式：等级: X | 当前伤害/所需伤害
满级显示：★ 等级: X (MAX) ★
指令：

/level - 查看自己的等级信息
/setmaxlevel <等级> - 实时修改最大等级上限（需要 op 权限）
配置：

默认最大等级：5 级
权限节点：watchoutyourlife.level（默认true），watchoutyourlife.setmaxlevel（默认op）
